qaNote: Portrait inspected. Preserve green patterned dashiki, locs, gold glasses, ankh and Africa book emblem. Fire and stone constructs are original folded-paper effects. Review green garment chroma integrity, book scale, title and sound.
choreography:
IDENTITY: the exact broad-built Black scholar with short upright locs, black goatee, large gold rectangular glasses, green dashiki with red-yellow-black geometric trim, gold beads and ankh pendant, loose black trousers and green/gold/black sneakers. His black hardback book has the reference's gold Africa silhouette. Keep that emblem, no crowns, no new written book text. No speech.
0–1.2s: establish his complete body and book against pure cyan. He adjusts his glasses, gives a stern "pay attention" look, then snaps the book open with both hands.
1.2–3.2s: the book unfolds into an IMPOSSIBLY enormous pop-up sculpture; camera rockets backward and upward to reveal two paper constructs twenty feet apart above him. One is a red-orange folded-paper bird blazing with outlined amber fire, the other a cream-and-charcoal folded-paper ram carrying floating stone facets. They are visibly made from angular book pages with distinct elements, never additional human characters. He directs each with a sharp conductor-like hand gesture as their paper bases extend from the book, cyan visible between every structure.
3.2–4.8s: both constructs launch in a sweeping spiral past him, the fire bird wrapping around the stone ram until they unite into one colossal flaming stone-and-paper battering ram. Camera races beside the combined creature as it surges thirty feet into depth and SLAMS into a finite suspended black-and-gold target disc. Huge red-orange starburst with flying cream folded-paper shards, a hard contact hold, then an explosive recoil. This is the dominant payoff; no scenery, planet, ground or fullscreen explosion.
4.8–6s: snap-zoom back to the scholar as he closes the book with a thunderous CLAP, instantly folding the distant constructs back into its pages. Exact title GROUP PROJECT slams in two large stable comic lines below his face.
6–8s: heroic full-body tableau. A single crumpled paper ball floats down onto the closed book. He unfolds it just enough to see a blank page, looks directly at the viewer with an exhausted unimpressed face, and tucks it away. No extra text. Strong readable title, cape-like dashiki settles. SFX: hard book snap, unfolding-paper thunder, fire rush and rocky rumble braided together, enormous collision, book clap, tiny final paper crinkle.
name: Dr. Umah

qaNote: Portrait inspected. Preserve curly-haired bespectacled man, sage overshirt, cream EV hatchback and charging connector. Review car and driver continuity, exact long title readability and isolated cyan around vehicle.
choreography:
IDENTITY: the exact slim adult man with tousled brown curls, short stubble, thin dark glasses, sage-green open overshirt, white T-shirt, dark cropped trousers and white sneakers. Preserve his ivory compact electric hatchback with black roof, dark windows and charging connector. No invented brand badges. He is the only person.
0–0.7s: complete character leans smugly against the car and twirls the charging connector once, pointing at it with his free hand.
0.7–2.5s: he plugs the connector into the car; its black cable instantly coils into a gigantic spring stretching thirty feet behind the vehicle. Camera pulls back hard to reveal the spring under impossible tension, then it RELEASES with an explosive gold electric shock ring. The car launches through the cyan void like a slingshot; he rides braced on the hood in a dramatic low surfing crouch, hand securely on the charging connector. Camera tracks alongside the rushing car, then whips in front as it swings into a huge controlled midair drift and stops close to camera. Powerful readable burst, finite black-ink-edged ivory/gold sparks and disconnected speed strokes. No street, floor, city, charger station or rectangular speed-line backdrop. Keep the vehicle silhouette and man intact.
2.5–3.5s: snap close to his absurdly calm smile, then reveal the car with him now casually leaning at its front fender. Exact title ACTUALLY, IT CHARGES FREE slams in three large readable comic lines, avoiding his face. No other text or numbers.
3.5–5s: the connector retracts neatly into his hand; his hair remains comically windswept while he gives the viewer the same smug little finger-point. The car settles with one last suspension bounce even in the cyan void. Hold a clean character-and-car hero tableau and stable title. SFX: connector click, huge elastic cable creak, electric slingshot KRAK, accelerating turbine whine, enormous braking whoosh, soft charging chime. No voice, dialogue or music.

qaNote: Portrait inspected. Foreman is the reference's older Black WOMAN with short white curls, yellow hardhat, navy shirt, tan trousers and orange extension cord. Review identity, cord continuity, title and navy chroma integrity.
choreography:
IDENTITY: preserve the exact authoritative older Black WOMAN, short silver-white curls under a yellow construction hardhat, gold hoop earrings, navy work shirt, tan work trousers with brown belt, heavy brown work boots, and coiled bright-orange extension cable. Strong foreman attitude; do not turn her into a man. No other people.
0–1.2s: full-body stance. She gives a sharp two-finger work assignment, then cracks the coil of orange extension cable open like a massive whip.
1.2–3.2s: camera whip-tracks the two cable ends as they fly outward in enormous opposite arcs, thirty feet apart, and plug into two sockets on a giant black-and-gold industrial circuit breaker floating behind her. The breaker is a finite sculptural foreground prop with an exposed massive red lever, never a rectangular scene or background panel; broad cyan space remains around it. Two separate amber electric charges race along the orange cables toward the device, visibly completing two jobs together.
3.2–4.8s: she braces both boots wide and YANKS the cable in a full-body power pull. The giant red breaker lever, taller than she is, slams from upright to fully down. A brutal metal-on-metal impact hold, then a colossal double-pronged golden lightning fork bursts above the device and unites in one enormous warm-white/gold impact star. Camera pulls impossibly wide to reveal the scale, then punches back toward her commanding face. No blue/cyan lightning, no floor or scenery; every electric branch ends naturally against cyan.
4.8–6s: exact title EVERYBODY ON THE CLOCK slams in three powerful comic lines below her face. The giant device collapses into two compact golden bolt-shaped energy badges, one at each cable end, visually showing both jobs powered up.
6–8s: she reels the cord back into its original neat coil, settles into the reference's commanding point and gives the viewer a raised eyebrow. One tiny loose spark sneaks along the cable; she pins the insulated cord with her boot and the spark stops with an embarrassed little click. Hero silhouette, both boots visible, stable title. SFX: thick cable whip, two separated plug CLACKS, racing electrical charge, immense industrial lever KLANG, thunderous double discharge, ratcheting cable recoil and final tiny click. No voices or music.
